Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
I cannot at all tell whether this is the right length, as the only ‘Golden Treasuries’ I have seen are my own and I do not think they have introductions.[^1]
I can easily add biographical details if you wish it to be longer - but I like to write to my own sense of the needs of the subject and to add or diminish afterwards as required.
Do you know whether [Mrs Ritchie](/person/1240) is abroad. I was moved to write to her by sympathy with her preface to Miss Mitford, and I have never had an answer

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY\'s [A Book of Golden Deeds](/book/51), [A Book of Worthies](/book/80) and [The Story of the Christians and the Moors in Spain](/book/126) all appeared in Macmillan\'s Golden Treasury Series. CMY was presumably working on her [introduction](/book/351) to the Golden Treasury edition of The Christian Year.
